lines.text: Then I have the honor of addressing the poet whose works have done so much to keep up my enthusiasm for my native land.
It is said that you do not write any more, but I could not learn the reason.
Because one does not seek inspiration in order to debase himself and lie.
One writer has been imprisoned for having put a very obvious truth into verse.
They may have called me a poet but they shall not call me a fool.
And may I enquire what that truth was?
He said that the lion’s son is also a lion.
He came very near to being exiled for it.
Kung gayon, ikinararangal kong makausap ang makatang ang mga isinulat ay nakatulong upang mapanatili ang aking masidhing pagmamahal sa aking bayan.
Nabalitaan kong hindi na raw po kayo sumusulat, ngunit hindi ko nalaman ang dahilan.
Sapagkat hindi hinahanap ang inspirasyon upang hamakin ang sarili at magsinungaling
Isang manunulat ang nilitis dahil isinulat niya sa tula ang isang katotohanang hindi maitatanggi.
Tinawag nila akong makata, ngunit hindi nila ako matatawag na hangal.
At maaari ko po bang malaman kung ano ang katotohanang iyon?
Sinabi lamang niya na ang anak ng leon ay leon din.
Muntik na siyang ipatapon dahil dito.
